# routeros_interface_pptp_server (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_interface_pptp_server" "settings" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `authentication` (String) Authentication algorithm.
- `default_profile` (String) Activate the default profile.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defines whether PPTP server is enabled or not.
- `keepalive_timeout` (String) Time period after which not responding client is proclaimed. Possible values: `disabled`.
- `max_mru` (Number) Maximum Receive Unit.
- `max_mtu` (Number) Maximum Transmission Unit.
- `mrru` (String) Possible values: `disabled`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_interface_pptp_server.settings .
```
